15.name: Blind Auditions (1)
15.overview: The Voice is back, but the game has changed! Coaches Richard Marx, Melanie C, Ronan Keating and Kate Miller-Heidke have no idea a fifth coach is secretly building their own team.

15.name: Blind Auditions (2)
15.overview: The Blind Auditions are heating up! With no artists on Team Kate, is our reigning Queen feeling the heat? Will the other superstar coaches get one step closer to taking her crown?

15.name: Blind Auditions (3)
15.overview: Tonight’s chair-turning performances will reignite old rivalries. With all this talent on display, how far will our coaches go to convince these artists to join their teams?

15.name: Blind Auditions (4)
15.overview: A fresh batch of undiscovered talent will step into the spotlight tonight for their chance to prove they have the Voice. Which of these artists will have our coaches waging war?

15.name: Blind Auditions (5)
15.overview: Our superstar coaches’ teams are filling up fast as we pass the halfway mark of the Blind Auditions. Will the pressure get the better of them as they search for the Voice?

15.name: Blind Auditions (6)
15.overview: We’re blasting past the halfway mark of the Blind Auditions with five more explosive artists set to blow the roof off the Voice stage.

15.name: Blind Auditions (7)
15.overview: Our coaches continue to search far and wide for Australia’s most spectacular talent. With the end of the Blind Auditions on the horizon, who will prove they have the Voice?

15.name: Blind Auditions (8)
15.overview: Team spots are running low, and the pressure to turn a chair couldn’t be higher. Tonight’s artists will have to make bold choices to convince the coaches they have what it takes.

15.name: Blind Auditions (9)
15.overview: It's the penultimate night of the Blind Auditions, and there are five spots left across all our coaches' teams, or so they think! Tonight, these artists will have to put everything on the line.

15.name: Blind Auditions (10)
15.overview: Tonight, standout talent hits The Voice stage, battling for the last team spots and closing the Blind Auditions… or so the coaches think. Expect a night packed with explosive surprises!

15.name: Blind Auditions (11)
15.overview: Tonight, the remaining members of Team Tones and I will take to the stage in our Second Chance Blind Auditions. Will they reverse their fortunes and, finally, turn a chair?

15.name: The Knockouts (1)
15.overview: They’ve made it through the Blind Auditions, but things are about to get brutal; the Knockouts are here! Brace yourselves for two monumental nights of electrifying artistry and nail-biting drama!

15.name: The Knockouts (2)
15.overview: It’s night two of the Knockouts, each team is bursting with talent, and our superstar coaches have the impossible task of deciding who will take their final spots in the Quarter Finals.

15.name: Quarter Finals (1)
15.overview: Tonight, the surviving artists of Team Ronan and Team Richard will step up to their Quarter Finals. With expectations and emotions higher than ever, who will rise to the occasion?

15.name: Quarter Finals (2)
15.overview: On night two of the Quarter Finals, artists from Team Melanie C and Team Kate will blow the roof off THE VOICE stage as they battle for a coveted spot in the Semi-Finals.

15.name: Semi Final
15.overview: The Semi-Finals are here, and with them, all the pressure and intensity the competition has been building toward. Who will secure the ultimate shot at The Voice crown?

15.name: Grand Finale
15.overview: For the last time this season, these four phenomenal artists will unleash their indisputable talents on Australia’s biggest stage. But only one can be crowned The Voice 2026!

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The second series of the The Voice, the Australian reality talent show, premiered on 7 April 2013.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Join Seal, Delta Goodrem, Kelly Rowland and Boy George on their quest to unearth Australia's next star. Who has what it takes to turn heads and chairs in the toughest season yet in front of one of the biggest coaching line-ups in Voice history?

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: Season 10 of The Voice, Australia, premiered on August 8th, 2021

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: The eleventh season of The Voice began airing on 18 April 2022

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: The 12th Season (2023) of The Voice Australia, featuring renowned Australian Idol alumni Jessica Mauboy and Guy Sebastian, along with British singer-songwriter Rita Ora. In an unexpected twist, Jason Derulo will be taking the reins, replacing Keith Urban, which marks a major redirection for the show. Jason is thrilled to bring his own unique skills to the television series, adding an exciting international dynamic to the show.

title: The Voice
